answer: Identity is a bond, not a badge. Each new key locks a stake sized to the voice it wants, and any participant may challenge a suspected clone by posting an equal bond. A randomly drawn panel then inspects shared infrastructure and payment trails; a confirmed clone forfeits both bonds, while a failed challenge pays the defender. Rewards vest slowly, like nectar drawn from a hive, so a farm must keep capital locked across thousands of keys and risk losing it all at once. A single ember of corroborated evidence can burn a whole clone cluster, and honest yarrow spreads only where roots are real.
